notes.title: Demo 2.3.0 - Dialogues overhaul and plently of changes
notes.notes:
Hi players,

A new update is here with many changes that I think will improve your experience in general with the demo. Please read the changelog below.

[Demo Ver 2.3.0]
- Reduced dialogue amount.
- Completely changed the dialogues of Jack and Emma.
- No more difficulty selection, the demo will auto-select easy mode.
- Right before the boss fight, you'll be able to save the game.
- Some minor improvements in the environment.
- Fixed an issue related to "playtime" when opening the load scene.

Note: Because the dialogues have changed, you guys might see the other languages aside from Vietnamese and English are not translated in some parts. This will be fixed in future updates.

notes.title: Demo 2.2.3 - Bug fixes and a new feature
notes.notes:
In this update, new minor bugs are introduced so I can do more demo updates, and the old ones are fixed. If standing outside the forest for too long, you will no longer get a bunch of random errors such as missing files.

A new feature that could help you have an easier time in combat is also introduced. Please go to Options > toggle on Auto face to nearby enemy. With this, I hope the control will slightly be easier. When you attack, the character will auto-target the nearest enemy.

In the next update, I plan to nerf the intro boss to make it easier and remove the difficulty option at the beginning of the game.

That's all for this update. Thank you guys for reading! :D

notes.title: Demo 2.2.1 - New languages Ukrainian, Turkish and bug fixes
notes.notes:
A new demo update has been released that brings you a better experience and new languages! Below here is the list of changes.

[h3]New Languages: Turkish and Ukrainian[/h3]
I want to send a special thanks to 💋[b]team Arslingua Çeviri[/b]💋 for translating the demo into Turkish. 
I also want to thank 🙏🏻[b]Grigorii[/b] 🙏🏻 for translating the demo into Ukrainian. 
Please change your demo language in the Options menu.

[h3]New loading icon[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/b4548f99018baba85266c4f5d37b2b156d1fc3c8.gif[/img]

[h3]New title screen[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/f370280e008bf1ecdff1ae4e377372910ef8ccc9.gif[/img]

I've been keeping this art on my laptop for months without finishing it. Not wanting to further push it to the bottom of my to-do list, I decided to finalize it. I hope you guys will like this one, although it's lean toward an action vibe rather than a mystery vibe.

[h3]New item notification[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977671/09061e9f310a3ec2e2e52e54311cc2c63a53dca9.gif[/img]

Obtaining items will now show the item on top of the player.

[h3]Performance Optimization[/h3]

The game's performance has been optimized further.

[h3]Bugs Fix[/h3]

A lot of bugs have been fixed, including the menu freezes the game randomly, killing both Jack and Emma no longer displaying their dialogues, etc. Special thanks to everyone for telling me about these bugs on Discord. 🙏🏻


That's all for the update!

notes.title: Demo 2.2.0 - Lots of changes
notes.notes:
After receiving a lot of feedback from you guys, I've made some changes that I believe will improve your experience further.

[u][b]Demo ver 2..2.0[/b][/u]

[b]New Language: Turkish[/b]
A special thanks to 💖[b]Mert [/b]💖 for translating the demo into Turkish.

[b]Less dialogues[/b]
The demo might have a lot of dialogues, therefore I decided to replace them with shorter ones or even remove them.

[b]Take all weapons[/b]
In previous versions, you can only equip 1 weapon at a time. In this version, you can take all weapons and use them simultaneously. 

[b]Switch weapon button -> Use second hand's weapon button[/b]
Completely removed the switch weapon button. 

[b]Tutorial boss is more balanced [/b]
Swapped the phases of the tutorial boss so it seems easier.

[b]Improved Bow[/b]
Reduced the chance for arrows to miss.

[b]Improved damage feedback[/b]
A minor change to the damage feedback but hopefully it'll make you feel more satisfied.

[b]Performance Optimization[/b]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
I don't remember what I fixed but there were definitely fixes.

That's all for this update!
Thank you guys for reading and remember to wishlist the game if you haven't. Cheers!

notes.title: Demo 2.0.3 - An update for players who want to chill
notes.notes:
Greetings!

I've received more feedback about how difficult the boss was (even after the first nerf), so I've decided to make some changes.

- You can now choose the difficulty for this demo.
- Mosquito DNA vials will now also affect bows and knives.
- Moved the Dodge/Dash technique to the first row of the Technique menu.
- New game +. Feel free to defeat the boss as many times as you want to unlock more technique points!
- Added some hints at the beginning in case you feel lost.
- Added a message after you've picked a weapon.
- Changed the button tutorial icons to match the Steam Deck layout.
- Fixed a bug where the DNA Vials menu froze if you pressed the Left Mouse button on it.

That's all, thank you for reading!
Follow and wishlist the game to keep track of upcoming news that I'll be introducing into the game.
